content: {"phoneNote":"The hero's two calls to action are identical underlined text links, so 'Pokličite nas' carries no more weight than 'Kako do nas', and the phone number itself only appears far down the page.","desktopNote":"Hero text card over the photo works, but the primary button falls below the fold and the 'Nadomestno vozilo' section leaves a tall empty column beside a photo that runs on past the text.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Turn the hero 'Pokličite nas' into a solid button showing the phone number and keep 'Kako do nas' as a secondary link; on desktop tighten the hero so the buttons sit above 800px.","Merge the closing 'Imate Audi…' CTA with the footer and drop one of the three 'Kako do nas' links; phone, address and directions currently appear four times.","Balance the 'Nadomestno vozilo' block (shorter photo or more content) and shrink the '2012' figure so the two bands stop reading as filler; turn off hyphenation on headings and names."],"blockers":["Desktop hero: the owner's name is hyphenated across lines as 'Gre-gor Kovač'."]}
